pages.text: Weavers are spider-like creatures with a distinct abdomen consisting of a rotating Memory Core. They use this organ to store the memories they extract from their victims and later weave them into Bloodweave. They will attack any living creature and as a side effect of consuming memories, the target will experience short-term Amnesia. They can only be found in colonies of nests.
The Amnesia they cause can easily lead the victim into panic and danger.

Upon death, they can drop Bones and rarely a Memory Core. These can be consumed as is, to gain experience, or be used to craft a Concentration Core. A Weaver that wanders out of its colony has the capability to create a new Weaver Nest once it has consumed sufficient memories.

There are two ways to obtain Bloodweave: one is to alter Cobwebs, and the other is to harvest it whenever a Weaver creates one through killing a creature. Bloodweave connects with itself and can form complex webs of memories; similar to a neural system. When pushed by a Piston, all connected Bloodweave will move together.
The Concentration core is a vital component for creating willful weapons. Usually these weapons can express unique abilities and also gain the capability of hurting divine beings, such as angels.
